{{Orphan|date=December 2024}}

'''Hanne N. Rasmussen''' (born 1950) is a Danish scientist who studies orchid-fungal symbioses.

== Career ==
She is currently a senior researcher at the [[University of Copenhagen]] in the Department of Geosciences and Natural Resource Management.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ign.ku.dk/english/employees/forest-nature-biomass/?pure=en/persons/hanne-nina-rasmussen(3d9a5aa1-c232-468d-9b54-e24669fe718d)/cv.html|title=Section for Forest, Nature and Biomass|last=IGN|date=2013-03-15|website=ign.ku.dk|language=en|access-date=2019-12-06}}</ref> Her research has included studies on numerous plant families, but the majority has focused on symbiotic relationships between various fungi and member of the [[Orchidaceae]] family. These relationships are called [[orchid mycorrhiza]].

Rasmussen is the author of the book ''Terrestrial Orchids: from seed to mycotrophic plant'' (1995).<ref>{{Cite book|title=Terrestrial Orchids|last=Rasmussen|first=Hanne N.|date=1995-08-24|publisher=Cambridge University Press|isbn=978-0-521-45165-9|doi = 10.1017/cbo9780511525452}}</ref> Her most cited articles are on the role of fungal symbionts in orchid seed germination and growth.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Rasmussen|first=Hanne N.|date=2002-07-01|title=Recent developments in the study of orchid mycorrhiza|journal=Plant and Soil|language=en|volume=244|issue=1|pages=149–163|doi=10.1023/A:1020246715436|s2cid=32913958|issn=1573-5036}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Rasmussen|first1=Hanne N.|last2=Whigham|first2=Dennis F.|date=1993|title=Seed ecology of dust seeds in situ: a new study technique and its application in terrestrial orchids|journal=American Journal of Botany|language=en|volume=80|issue=12|pages=1374–1378|doi=10.1002/j.1537-2197.1993.tb15381.x|issn=1537-2197|url=https://curis.ku.dk/ws/files/126329352/Seed_ecology_of_dust_seed_in_situ.pdf}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Rasmussen|first1=Hanne N.|last2=Rasmussen|first2=Finn N.|date=2009|title=Orchid mycorrhiza: implications of a mycophagous life style|journal=Oikos|language=en|volume=118|issue=3|pages=334–345|doi=10.1111/j.1600-0706.2008.17116.x|issn=1600-0706}}</ref>
